exposure: serum TSH levels in early pregnancy
serum FT4 levels in early pregnancy
cohort: The study included 46,474 singleton pregnancies and 1,183 twin pregnancies from a tertiary hospital.
finding: Twin-specific thyroid reference intervals established in early pregnancy can improve high-risk pregnancy identification, with low TSH significantly associated with preeclampsia and low FT4 linked to SGA, LGA, emergency cesarean delivery, and fetal distress.
mod_finding: Low FT4 levels were linked to an increased risk of emergency cesarean delivery.
